_readme: Explicit exemptions for scripts/compliance/subprocessor-reconcile.mjs. An exemption means: this provider id / host / env var is seen in code but is intentionally NOT on the public sub-processor list. Every entry needs a concrete reason (20+ chars) and a review flag containing [VERIFY] or [COUNSEL]. Do not add an entry just to make CI green - a provider that receives customer or end-user personal data belongs on the public list instead. Stale entries (matching nothing in code) produce a warning.

entries.reason: esm.sh / jsDelivr serve code imported by edge functions at runtime; no customer data is sent to them (supply-chain dependency, not a data processor).
entries.review: [VERIFY] confirm no customer data is ever placed in URLs or headers sent to these hosts

entries.reason: Public open-data endpoints (NWS, Census, FEMA, NASA, EIA, USGS, Open-Meteo, OSM Nominatim/OSRM, zippopotam, ipwho.is, FX). No account or contract with Vireek. Some receive addresses, coordinates or IP addresses.
entries.review: [COUNSEL] decide whether address/coordinate/IP lookups to these services make them sub-processors or require a documented exception; [VERIFY] which endpoints receive end-customer data

entries.reason: fonts.googleapis.com / fonts.gstatic.com appear only in the CSP allowlist; no source file or index.html references them.
entries.review: [VERIFY] confirm no page loads Google Fonts; if one does, add it to the public list (browser IP address is disclosed to Google) or self-host the fonts

entries.reason: app.glitchtip.com appears only in the CSP; src/lib/sentry.ts treats the DSN as Sentry-compatible. It is used only if VITE_SENTRY_DSN points at GlitchTip.
entries.review: [VERIFY] confirm production DSN host; if GlitchTip is used it must be listed

entries.reason: *.banuba.cloud appears only in the CSP; no source file references Banuba.
entries.review: [VERIFY] confirm whether any feature loads Banuba; otherwise remove it from the CSP

entries.reason: *.pluot.blue appears only in the CSP; the vendor is unidentified and no source file references it.
entries.review: [VERIFY] identify the vendor and the feature that needed it; otherwise remove it from the CSP

entries.reason: YouTube (nocookie) and Vimeo players are allowed as embeds in help-center content; they load only when an article containing an embed is opened.
entries.review: [COUNSEL] decide whether optional embeds need a public-list entry; [VERIFY] which articles embed video
